notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
After many long hard working years, Gemini is now feature complete, with the release of the ‘Incursion’ game mode. Returning to our co-op roots, we wanted to make sure we created the kind of mode players actually wanted, as well as forming as a basis for future projects.

Incursion is an objective based co-op experience, in it’s new map ‘inc_tundra’ you and your squad play as a small covert group of Trivexians tasked with sneaking into a fortified Avian base under the cover of darkness. Your team perform various acts of espionage and destruction, ultimately destroying the shield bubble that lead to the events of the original tundra holdout mission; this map officially being a ‘prequel’ to that. The mode has some depth, featuring stealth mechanics, sabotage, large open spaces, patrols, and more, making it an incredibly engaging and exciting mission, with every action you take leaving lasting effects on the later stages of the operation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/03a040c818dff244b77151ba291d728828645797.jpg

At the start of Incursion, your first objective is to sabotage one of two fortified locations. These are the Droid Factory, and the Armoury, both providing essential supplies to the Avian side.

Sabotaging the Droid Factory, reduces Droid spawns from there-in, making Super Droids, Poppers, etc... much less of a present threat, while the Armoury, once sabotaged, reduces the amount of armoured specialist units, meaning that the Avian soldiers on patrols or reinforcement waves will be much less equipped to deal with you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/4c3328198a670c85982dc21deb629c3f8532b39f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/f452e750a81cbbbc575173d079dc64354a0e734b.jpg

That doesn't mean sabotage will be straightforward however. In your efforts to shut down and destroy their capabilities in this large open space, you will encounter guards patrolling major locations. These patrols wander the map and vehemently guard points of interest, and your approach to these patrols is essential.

You can stealth around them, taking units out either from behind or from a distance before anyone can raise the alarm, sneak past them to sabotage equipment right from under their nose, or go in full guns blazing, throwing caution to the wind and wiping out assault waves in a blaze of glory. Your approach is entirely up to you, but it directly influences how many enemies you have to deal with, which path you take, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/164bdb35830bfbfc2bd89990f44a490a0cd448da.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/57ad6e8a07e6f31ffc0c42213af5ddf7570c4c0f.jpg

Then, after sabotaging the shield bubble with a piece of equipment you obtain from a drop ship in one of multiple cave locations, and subsequently securing the main temple, you must fight an intense boss battle. A hyper lethal version of the Holdout gunship boss, having more health and abilities than the original Holdout gunship. You're team will face a difficult challenge as reinforcements trickle in to support the boss as you attempt to thwart it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/70dd89b02bf1113ea6c45b57b9e5f977e0d8cb1c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/8069dd8baeff3b99377a5f5f8acd3985dc96b30d.jpg

Finally, once all is said and done, your team has to rendezvous to the evac point, dealing with a final patrol which triggers an endless wave of units constantly assaulting you and your team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/743de3fba48bd564563d46abc04f71a54a14d1b3.jpg

Incursion is a love-letter to not only our original works, but was also a mode we wanted to create for Gemini for quite some time. It’s become a wonderful base for future projects moving forward and we're extremely proud of it. We very much look forward to you all enjoying playing it!

Speaking of "returning to our roots", we have some big plans moving forward, which will be discussed soon. Stay tuned for more updates on that.

notes.title: Gemini - Spelunk Update
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the release of three new Gemini maps!

A new subaquatic warpath battleground ‘wp_spelunk’! Alongside its free-for-all counterpart ‘fdm_spelunk’ and of course for good measure a team deathmatch version of the truly magnificent ‘magmastation’. 

If you are interested in some real combat verticality, do come and check out what spelunk has to offer, not only with its (quite literally) wonderfully ‘immersed’ visuals, but wild gameplay to match. There's something for everyone to love in this avian underwater jaunt!

[previewyoutube=u4MW6QVknkI;full][/previewyoutube]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/89e2b8b325f4896fed85743c578d966db8890d5d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/4b9d531cf2912f5110ee6b82e259b13b211d622f.png
Also in this update:
- added a system for dedicated servers to reload the ‘serversettings’ config file on map change (so certain settings can be changed while server is running)
- workaround for a bot ho/unearthed repair issue
- fixed new lag comp system only working for the first shot of the burst on burster/repulse
- attempted to make client/server shots match up better on the shooting clients side

notes.title: Gemini Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the release of 'Gemini: Binary Conflict' into steam early access! 

The passion project of just two people, Gemini has been a labour of love for a number of years. It's now finally ready for public release and we invite those who would enjoy a good scrap on a hostile alien planet to come and check it out!

Sling black holes at each other and slice people in half! Rebound projectiles around the corner and take down snot pelting gunships - or get shoved around by giant robots; to name but a few of the features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573758/52330cb9fa2dd1244f85e5e7b4b8c0084d6fe748.gif

With up to 16 player PvP, 5 player Coop or even just offline play with full AI bot support, there's something for everyone when it comes to a battle arena shooter. Come and support us and join the action of an interplanetary war!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293660/Gemini_Binary_Conflict/
